programs.title: Spring Break
programs.desc: College guys (David Knell, Steve Bassett, Perry Lang) team up for beer, silly contests and friendship with girls in Fort Lauderdale, Fla.

programs.title: Elektra Luxx
programs.desc: A favor for a woman from her past throws the life of a pregnant, retired porn star (Carla Gugino) into chaos.

programs.title: Dark Country
programs.desc: Terror strikes traveling newlyweds (Thomas Jane, Lauren German) when they try to help an injured man in the Nevada desert.

programs.title: Jack Reed: Death and Vengeance
programs.desc: A Chicago police detective links the murders of immigrants to a Russian con artist, not a local labor dispute.

programs.title: Toy Soldiers
programs.desc: Colombian terrorist Luis Cali (Andrew Divoff) takes an American prep school hostage as a means of gaining his drug lord father's freedom. Privileged yet rebellious students Joey (Wil Wheaton), Billy (Sean Astin), Snuffy (Keith Coogan) and Hank (T.E. Russell) find that they are better equipped to deal with the threat than the mostly ineffectual government agencies sent to rescue them. With resourceful Billy as their leader, the students struggle to defeat the terrorists and save the school.

programs.title: Sniper: Reloaded
programs.desc: A sharpshooter (Chad Michael Collins) must kill another sniper before he becomes a target.

programs.title: The Return of Eliot Ness
programs.desc: In 1947 Chicago, detective Eliot Ness comes out of retirement after the murder of Martin Labine, a former cop suspected of Mafia connections. As an old colleague, Ness takes the case extremely personally, and makes it his sole mission to track down whoever's responsible for the crime. Along the way, Ness partners with Labine's son, Gil, as they delve into the Mafia. Meanwhile, the two have to avoid ending up casualties in the ongoing gang war.

programs.title: Universal Soldier: Day of Reckoning
programs.desc: Archenemies Luc Devereaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) and Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren) contend with a terrifying army of reanimated super soldiers.

programs.title: Armored
programs.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm risk their lives when they embark on a heist against their own company. Armed with a seemingly fool-proof plan, the men plan on making off with a fortune with harm to none. But when an unexpected witness interferes, the plan quickly unravels and all bets are off.

programs.title: Blue Thunder
programs.desc: Frank Murphy is a courageous and honorable Los Angeles police officer who is chosen to test run Blue Thunder, a high-tech experimental attack helicopter. While flying Blue Thunder, Murphy and his partner discover that the government intends to use the helicopter for corrupt crowd control and surveillance.

programs.title: The Final Countdown
programs.desc: A time warp takes the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and its captain (Kirk Douglas) back to Pearl Harbor, Dec. 6, 1941.

programs.title: The Lodger
programs.desc: A husband and wife rent out a room in their West Hollywood home to a man who may be responsible for murdering a string of prostitutes.
